# recipe-book documentation

> Index of the documentation for recipe-book, the Nag Family Recipes site.

The Markdown files are the source of truth.
Read AGENTS.md first for conventions.

## Documents

- [01 Overview](01-overview.md): What the recipe site is, how it is put together, and what is in and out of scope.
- [02 Recipes](02-recipes.md): The recipe file format, the three sources and their syncs, the slug rule, and the Claude rewrite.
- [03 Deploy](03-deploy.md): How the site is hosted on Cloudflare Workers, how a push deploys it, and how to check a deploy.

## Machine-readable data

- [Manifest](data/manifest.json): every document with its metadata, dependencies and section anchors
- [Glossary](data/glossary.json): terms and definitions

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): conventions for agents reading or editing these documents
- [index.html](index.html): all documents as one static page for people
